policy.production: DeepSeek director, creator and independent reviewer; all high; no external candidate edits
policy.versions: Use the unchanged learning-workflow-v3 profile; freeze implementation before first production request
policy.evaluation: Same learning rubric, evidence density and independent publication gates as Sol v3
policy.comparison: One development sample; provider and reasoning level differ, so this is not an isolated model-only causal test
policy.isolation: Fresh project and role contexts; exclude old films, scripts, source, reviews, main conversation, memory and outside editorial suggestions
policy.accounting: Keep every request, failure, raw usage and production wall time; unknown usage is not zero cost

brief.audience: 已接触速度与重力的高中学生
brief.goal: 解释同高度水平抛出、忽略空气阻力时，横向初速度改变射程但不改变落地时间，并能预测改变高度后的结果。

facts.model: 质点、均匀重力场、无空气阻力、初始竖直速度为零；比较横速时初始高度相同
facts.coordinates: x=vx*t, y=h-g*t*t/2, ground y=0, y axis upwards

brief.guidance: 原创表达，独立选择例子、叙事与画面，不接受旧片、旧讲稿、分镜或逐片修改意见。
review_standards: 科学与画面一致，条件清楚
因果有画面或推导依据，不只宣告结论
观众可辨认关键过程与前后对应
字幕与动作不产生意义矛盾
视觉清楚且精简，完整连续
